name: paperforge
description: Agent-native paper-writing system: structured intake, claims-to-evidence outlining, grounded drafting, verified citations, polish passes, a 5-reviewer mock panel, and revision/rebuttal — plus commands that scaffold a paper workspace from the bundled template. Works alongside Project Steward (the template's AGENTS.md §12 defines the composition).

interface.shortDescription: Write, review, and revise academic papers.
interface.longDescription: Paperforge packages an agent-native academic paper workflow: intake, outlining, grounded drafting, related work, polishing, mock review, revision, and workspace scaffolding from a portable template.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Paperforge paper workspace.
Start the intake interview for this paper.
Run a mock review panel for this manuscript.
